text:
Maria Chen: FYI vendor kickoff moved to next Monday (2026-07-06). Need final intake: RBAC scope, KMS access matrix, audit export destination, remediation owners + retest window. I'll draft the intake form and epic.
AJ Patel: I can take RBAC. Proposal: create `pen-test-readonly` role scoped to the `production-*` namespaces with explicit deny on write/delete and console IAM changes. Token TTL 5 days. I will add a cert-based session for vendor operators.
Lee Nguyen: KMS: we should not expose prod CMKs. Plan: create dedicated test CMK per vendor in a `pen-testing` account/project. Policy limits key usage to `Encrypt` and `GenerateDataKey` only; `Decrypt` disabled unless we do a supervised operation. Rotate keys after test.
Sam Ortiz: Logs: central S3 `s3://sec-pen-test-archive` with Object Lock (compliance mode) 730d retention. Enable verbose audit (cloudtrail + k8s audit) for the 72h test window and forward to the bucket + Splunk index `pen-test`. Also enable session recordings (SSM) and store recordings in the same bucket. I'll post the export runbook.
Maria Chen: Can someone paste minimal IAM & KMS policy snippets for the intake doc? Also note: legal needs the vendor ATO and SOC2 attestation before we hand over any creds.
AJ Patel: IAM role snippet (minimal):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-readonly"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["ec2:TerminateInstances","s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Lee Nguyen: KMS key policy (AWS-style sketch):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Sid":"AllowUseForEncrypt","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/pen-test-vendor"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"},
    {"Sid":"DenyDecrypt","Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/pen-test-vendor"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Sam Ortiz: Also: we need an acceptance criteria doc for remediation: fixes verified by reproducing PoC, unit/regression tests where applicable, and evidence in the ticket (screenshots, logs, PR links).
Maria Chen: Proposed remediation sprint: 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-26. Proposed retest window: 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-07. Owners: AJ (RBAC), Lee (KMS), Sam (Logging). Legal & InfoSec need to sign off by 2026-07-09. Any blockers?
AJ Patel: :thumbsup: I'll open PR for role + TTL automation and attach to SEC-4410. Need platform sign-off on assume-role flow.
Lee Nguyen: :white_check_mark: I added key creation/rotation playbook to the ticket. Need ops to approve cross-account key usage.
Sam Ortiz: :eyes: Will create the S3 export and Splunk pipeline. One blocker: S3 Object Lock requires bucket versioning; ops to confirm no conflicts with existing lifecycle rules.
ops-bot: Note: created infra task INFRA-2209 for bucket provisioning and Object Lock config.
sec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4410 34 Pen test intake + RBAC/KMS/Logging checklist. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4410
Maria Chen: Nice. I'll publish the intake form and epic tonight and send calendar invites for the supervised KMS window. Remember: no permanent keys, all access strictly TTL-limited.
AJ Patel: Quick reminder: vendor will ask for service account tokens for automation. Prefer ephemeral sessions (OIDC) where possible.
Lee Nguyen: Agreed. If they need CI flow tests, issue short-lived data keys and require we mediate decrypt via a supervised job.
Sam Ortiz: I'll draft a verification checklist for retest: PoC repro, log evidence, PR link, test artifacts. Will attach to SEC-4410 when done.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. If anyone needs SOC/Legal contact info, DM me and I'll connect you. I'll close the intake doc once owners are linked to the epic.
